content: Yesu topeu ꞌaigeda ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya
Coinega Yesu wagai ꞌigeluwa ma ꞌihabala hila ꞌina gogowa.

Ma ꞌaigeda topeu boda siꞌahaliya ꞌina ꞌebeꞌeno ꞌoina ma sinaoleyama Yesu ꞌoina. Bodaedi ꞌidi hemisa Yesu ꞌisanapuya ma topeu ꞌihegwaeya ꞌigwae, “Natugu, ꞌuyaliyaya, ꞌino mumuga galadi ꞌadi nuwasam ꞌuloba pwaiya.”
Ma tupwadi loina ꞌana toheꞌitao Yesu ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya ma taudimo sihehegwaegwae sigwae, “Yesuina ꞌigwaegwae hopaꞌala Yehoba ꞌoina.”
Cidi nuwatuhuina Yesu ꞌisanapu pwaiya ma ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Toꞌaha weyahina ꞌatemiyega wanuwanuwatuhu galana?
Ma toꞌaha wanuwatuhuya yada gwae loheya bewa ꞌoina ma ꞌabehega yagwae, ‘Cino mumuga galana yanuwasam pwaiya’, nuwana yada gwae, ‘Cutoholo ma ꞌutauya’?

Ma wasanapu ꞌabehega taugu Loheyaiguina baleꞌuwa ma sawesawehigu tomota ꞌidi mumuga galana yanuwasamudi.” Coinega topeuina ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Cutoholo ma ꞌino ꞌebeꞌeno ꞌuꞌahali ma ꞌutauya ꞌino gogowa.”
Coinega topeuina ꞌitoholowa ma ꞌitauya ꞌina gogowa.’
Ma bodaedi paihowa bewa siꞌiteya ma maꞌidi heꞌasisi Yehoba sihehepwatuwe, weyahina tauna Yesu ꞌana toꞌabihewaiwai.
Yesu Madiu ꞌibwauweya

Coinega Yesu tupwa bewa ꞌiꞌebesineya ma ꞌitauya, ma loheya ꞌaigeda ꞌiꞌiteya, sanina Madiu, takesi ꞌana hada ꞌebe paihowa ꞌalona ꞌimiyamiya, ꞌoinega ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Madiu, ꞌumuliyegau.” Ta Madiu ꞌitoholowa ma Yesu ꞌimuliyeya.
Muliyetega hada ꞌaigeda ꞌoina Yesu ꞌiluhuwa sabi ꞌai ma tolopui gide takesi ꞌana toꞌewao ma tolopui tupwadi wete sinaoma, ma Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao maꞌiyadiyao simiyatoiya.
Coinega tupwadi Palisiyao siꞌiteya ma Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya sihesilala, sigwae, “Toꞌaha weyahina ꞌimi toheꞌita takesi ꞌana toꞌewao ma wete togala tupwadi baꞌidanao siꞌaiꞌai hegogona?”
Ma Yesu gwae bewa ꞌihesagoheya ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Taudi wahidi waiwaidi geya nuwadi toꞌabihebwebweꞌana, ma tolohalao hesi.
Coinega ꞌilobwainegomiya ma Yehoba ꞌina gwae wanuwa sabwalena Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina, ꞌigwaeya,
Bewa yanaoma geya tobwebweꞌana weyahidi, ma hesi topui sabi ꞌabihetedi.”
Yesu ꞌina gwae hudi weyahina
Ta Yoni ꞌana tomuliyao sinaoma ma Yesu sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Tauma ma Palisiyao ꞌima tapwalolo weyahina ꞌai ꞌoinega ꞌahudi, ma togidega ma ꞌoinega ꞌowa ꞌa tomuliyao geya sida hudi?”

Coinega Yesu gwae hegehegedi ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Togidega, sawasawahina hai ꞌana toyoꞌowao sinuwagala ꞌeguma tohai meloheyana maꞌiyadiu siyaliyaliyaya? Nuwana geya, ꞌawa? Ma wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega tuta ꞌinaonaoma ma tohaiina ꞌiꞌebesinedi, ma hesi sinuwagala ma ꞌeꞌahai ꞌoinega siꞌetala heꞌasisi.”
Ma ꞌaigeda wete gwae hegehegedi ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Geya sawasawahina ma ꞌaleꞌo ꞌehauna tupwatupwana ꞌaleꞌo miyamiyana tabwabwada, ꞌamuge gide taigalaina ꞌilotaigalasehe.

Ma geya wete sawasawahina ma weꞌaha ꞌehauna ma waiwaina tasiwa ꞌwapi ꞌebesiwa miyamiyana ꞌoina. Ceguma bewa gide tapaipaihowa ꞌese, weꞌaha ꞌina seseha ꞌoinega ꞌwapiina ꞌilotaigala, ma weꞌahaina ꞌilotasiwa, ma ꞌoinega ꞌebesiwaina ꞌigala. Ma ꞌilobwaineya ma weꞌaha ꞌehauna ma waiwaina tasiwa ꞌebesiwa ꞌehauna ꞌalona, ma ꞌoinega mabwaiyana bwebweꞌana.”
Yesu wahiwahine ꞌeluwa ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya
Cabwa Yesu ꞌihehegwaegwae ma ꞌaigeda toloina ꞌinaoma ma Yesu matana ꞌiꞌahetulasa, ma ꞌigwae, “Bada, natugu wahinena nige ꞌiꞌamasa, ma nuwanuwagu ꞌunaoma ma wahina ꞌuꞌabitoho ma ꞌitoholo hila.”
Ma Yesu ꞌitoholowa ta maꞌana tomuliyao toloinaina simuliyeya,
ma sitautauya, ma wahine ꞌaigeda bweyahina ꞌidaudau bolime tuwelo ꞌoidiya mulidiyega ꞌinaoma, ma Yesu ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo papalina ꞌiꞌabitohoya.
Weyahina ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌatena ꞌigwaeya, “Ceguma tuwa Yesu ꞌana ꞌaleꞌomo yaꞌabitoho, nata yabwebweꞌana.”
Ma Yesu ꞌiloꞌitahila ta wahineina ꞌiꞌiteya, ma ꞌigwae, “Yauwedo natugu, ꞌino hemisega ꞌubwebweꞌana pwaiya.” Ma tuta nage ꞌoina wahineina ꞌibwebweꞌana.
Coinega Yesu ꞌitauya ma toloinaina ꞌina hada ꞌilatuwa ma ꞌiꞌiteya todou sidoudou ma lololi ꞌana tomuꞌao lololi simuꞌamuꞌadi, ta ꞌenadi madou hedada.
Ta Yesu ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Walatu. Gwama bewa geya ꞌiꞌamasa, ma hesi ꞌiꞌeno sineya.” Ma simaluweya.
Eeta bodaedi silatuwa ma Yesu ꞌiluhuwa ma gwamaina nimana ꞌiꞌabiya, ta mayawasina ꞌitoholowa.
Muliyetega wasaina bewa ꞌiꞌedadana tupwa mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya.
Yesu tomata gibugibu ꞌeluwa ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya
Tupwa nage ꞌoinega Yesu ꞌitautauyama, tomata gibugibu ꞌeluwa simuliyeya, ma sibwaubwau ꞌenadi madouna ꞌoinega, sigwae, “Debida tubuna ee, ꞌuꞌatemuyemuyemai!”
Ta hadai ꞌiluhuwa ma tomata gibugibuwedi sinaoma ꞌoina, ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, “Togidega wahemisegauwa ꞌabehega sawasawahigu matami yaꞌabi heꞌasilala?” Ma taudi sigwae, “Bada, sawasawahiu.”
Coinega matadi ꞌiꞌabitohodiya ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Cimi hemisa ꞌoidiyega matami siꞌasilala,”
ma matadi siꞌasilala. Ma Yesu loina paꞌalina ꞌiꞌebwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Sahena taiya ꞌoina wahehepwailegau.”
Ta hesi sitauya, ma Yesu ꞌina loina siligehiya, ma ꞌina paihowaina sihepwaila dadaneya tupwa mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya.
Yesu buwa ꞌaigeda ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya
Ma Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao sitautauya, ma ꞌaigeda loheya welabana memenana sibuiya sitoeyama Yesu ꞌoina.

Ma ꞌoinega Yesu welabana ꞌipaꞌiya, ma loheyaina ꞌibwebweꞌana ma ꞌihegwaegwae. Ma boda maꞌidi yaliyaya Yesu siꞌahwa bwebweꞌaneya, ma sigwae, “Geya ꞌeta taiya ꞌina paihowa bewa gide taꞌita Isileli ꞌalona.”
Ma hesi Palisiyao sigwaeya, “Welabanao ꞌidi bada ꞌina waiwaiyega Yesu welabanao ꞌipaꞌipaꞌidi, ma geya Yehoba ꞌina waiwaiyega.”
Yesu tomota ꞌiꞌatemuyemuyediya

Ta Yesu ꞌasa madoudi ma ꞌiꞌiudi ꞌoidiya ꞌisakowasiya ma ꞌidi hada tapwalolowao ꞌoidiya ꞌiheꞌita ma ꞌiloguguya Yehoba ꞌina loina tetelina weyahina, ma wete lohala baibaiwana ꞌoidiyega tomota ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya.
Ma boda ꞌiꞌitediya ma ꞌiꞌatemuyemuyediya, weyahina ꞌadi mwauwao ꞌoidiyega geya ꞌadi toꞌabihetenamo, gide sipi ꞌwaniꞌwanidi, geya ꞌadi toꞌitayahinamo.
Ma ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihegwaediya, “Mamasalai bwebweꞌana, ma toꞌeliꞌeli ꞌomi hisahisamimo.
Coinega tanoha taniwagana ꞌoina waꞌahwanoi ma topaihowao wete ꞌihesumanedi, ꞌina tanoha siꞌeli.”
